current_behavior:
**(1) Does any staff login REQUIRE a paid SMS OTP today? No.** admin/login.php has four doors. Default office door = username + password only: `Auth::adminLogin()` (includes/auth.php:154-263) verifies bcrypt and calls `finishAdminSession()` unless the account id is in the `admin_2fa_ids` JSON setting (auth.php:230, 350-364). 2FA is opt-in per account (change-password.php:26-40 self-service; staff.php:261-272 superadmin can switch it off) and DEFAULT OFF; local fixture DB has `admin_2fa_ids = []` (live value could not be verified — no DB access). When 2FA is on the code goes to WhatsApp and, if `sms_send_otp` is true, also to Twilio SMS (auth.php:233-240; seed.sql:109 seeds `sms_send_otp = 1`). Default agent door (`?portal=agent`) = email + username + password, "no OTP, no WhatsApp" (`Auth::agentPasswordLogin`, auth.php:604-668; login.php:114-118). The older agent code + registered mobile + WhatsApp OTP door is one click away (`?auth=otp`, auth.php:521-588; also sends paid SMS when `sms_send_otp`, auth.php:549-551). WhatsApp-chat login (includes/walogin.php) is behind `wa_login_on` (default 0, walogin.php:63-66) and always demands an OTP for manager/superadmin (walogin.php:59, 250). **What happens when Twilio is down:** `adminLogin` only checks that the OTP row was MINTED (`!empty($otp['ok'])`, auth.php:234) and ignores `Notify::whatsapp()`'s return; that method never throws — on a paused/unconfigured/refused sender it logs a click-to-chat link and returns the link string (notify.php:428-449). So a 2FA-enabled admin is held at `admin_2fa_pending` with no code in hand; the "no lockout" branch (auth.php:251-253) only fires on mint failure. Rescue = another superadmin on staff.php `reset_2fa`; if the only superadmin has 2FA on, there is no in-app path.

**(2) Password recovery:** none for staff. No forgot-password route, no reset table/token (`grep -ri forgot|password_reset` finds only the login-page text), no CLI tool. login.php:305 says "Forgot your details? The office can view or reset your email, username and password" and :341 shows the office phone. Resets are superadmin-only: staff.php `resetpw` (151-176) and `setcreds` (177-205) → `Auth::setStaffCredentials` (auth.php:684-768, clears locked_until); agent.php Login-credentials panel (staff.manage). **Email IS implemented and configurable:** `Notify::email()` (notify.php:86-108) uses a native fsockopen SMTP client with STARTTLS/SSL + AUTH LOGIN (126-260) when `smtp_host` is set, else PHP `mail()`; keys `smtp_host/port/user/pass/secure`, `mail_from_name`, `email_enabled` are seeded (seed.sql:111-119), editable in admin/settings.php with `smtp_pass` write-only (settings.php:62-65, 293-312), and a "Test email (Gmail SMTP)" panel calls `Notify::emailTest` (settings.php:448-462; notify.php:2488-2510). Nothing in auth uses email today. Local `smtp_host` is empty; live value could not be verified.

**(3) Hashing / sessions / throttling:** passwords bcrypt via `Security::hashPassword` cost 11 (security.php:451-459); staff.php create/resetpw use `password_hash(PASSWORD_DEFAULT)` directly (staff.php:74, 170). Unknown-user timing is equalised with a dummy verify (auth.php:187). OTP codes stored bcrypt-hashed, 6 digits, 10 min, max 5 attempts (auth.php:1090-1100; otp_codes.max_attempts default 5). Session: name SHGSESSID, cookie Secure (when HTTPS)/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax, `use_strict_mode`, 3h lifetime (bootstrap.php:168-184; live `Set-Cookie: … Max-Age=10800; path=/; secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax` verified by curl), id rotated every 30 min (bootstrap.php:187-192), regenerated on login (auth.php:412), logout (782), password change (change-password.php:93); idle timeout `session_timeout_min` = 45 (auth.php:799-803); admins row re-read every 30 s so deactivation/role change bites within half a minute (auth.php:818-851). HSTS + CSP sent live. Throttling: per-IP DB buckets `admin_login`/`agent_pw_login`/`agent_otp` 5 per 5 min then 15-min block (auth.php:164, 526, 615) and `admin_2fa_verify`/`agent_otp_verify` 10 per 10 min (285, 569); per-ACCOUNT `failed_logins` → `locked_until` 15 min after 5 (auth.php:204-211, 650-655); OTP issue 1/min, 6/hour per identifier (1075-1079). The rate_limits upsert is atomic (security.php:282-297). `Security::clientIp()` trusts CF-Connecting-IP / X-Real-IP / X-Forwarded-For from any client (security.php:483-489); whether nginx overwrites them is not in the repo (could not verify). CSRF: session token, `hash_equals`, header or POST (security.php:127-140); login form carries it (login.php:127).

**(4) Server-side role enforcement — sampled endpoints:** admin/accounting.php `admin_boot('payments.view')` (22); admin/payments.php payments.view + `requireAdmin('payments.verify'|'payments.reject')` per action (15, 62-67); admin/refunds.php refunds.view + refunds.process on POST (18, 29); admin/staff.php dashboard.view, every POST refused unless superadmin (12-33); admin/export.php bookings.view, agent-scoped only (45, 54); admin/offers.php payments.view, manage on payments.verify (19-21); admin/api/schedule-action.php schedules.manage (47); admin/api/bulk-cancel.php bookings.view + `Auth::mayCancelBooking` (27); api/cancel.php phone-match OR owner OR bookings.cancel (41-49); api/kv.php writes need dashboard.view except `livebus` (61-64, 191); api/quick-ticket.php & api/book.php `isSellingStaff()` (quick-ticket.php:81, book.php:29); api/push.php other-phone lookup needs dashboard.view (137). `requireAdmin` returns JSON 401/403 for `/api/` URIs and a branded 403 page otherwise (auth.php:977-1052). **Financial pages reachable by counter/official:** `counter` holds `payments.view/verify/reject` (auth.php:91-92) and `official` holds `payments.view` (79), so both open admin/accounting.php (company-wide collections, commissions owed, refunds, agent cash) and counter can manage offers; counter also gets the unscoped bookings export (export.php:45,54) because `bookingScopeAdminId()` scopes only role=agent (auth.php:921-924). `reports.export` is declared for accountant (auth.php:60) but enforced nowhere outside tests.

gaps.title: No staff password recovery at all — only a superadmin can reset; locked-out superadmin has no path
gaps.evidence: admin/login.php:305 `Forgot your details? The office can view or reset your email, username and password.`; admin/login.php:341 `Help / locked out? … +91 91048 01507`; no route/table: `grep -ri "forgot|password_reset|reset_token"` hits only that text; staff.php:151-176 (`resetpw`) and 177-205 (`setcreds`) are inside `elseif (!$isSuper) { 'Only a super-admin can manage staff.' }` (staff.php:32-33); Notify::email exists (includes/notify.php:86-108) but no auth path calls it.
gaps.proposed_change: Add a signed-link email reset reusing existing helpers. (a) `admin/forgot-password.php`: GET shows username-or-email field; POST: `Security::verifyCsrf()`, `Security::rateLimit('pw_forgot_ip', ip, 5, 900, 900)` + `rateLimit('pw_forgot_acct', adminId, 3, 3600)`; look up `admins WHERE (username=:u OR LOWER(email)=:u) AND is_active=1 AND email IS NOT NULL`; ALWAYS render the same 'If that account has an email on file, a link has been sent' (no enumeration); if found call new `Auth::issuePasswordReset(int $adminId): string` which inserts into existing `otp_codes` (identifier `pwreset:<id>`, purpose `reset`, channel `email` — both enum values already exist, schema.sql otp_codes) with `code_hash = password_hash($nonce)`, expires 30 min, after `UPDATE otp_codes SET is_used=1` for older reset rows; token = `$id . '.' . $exp . '.' . $nonce . '.' . Security::sign("$id.$exp.$nonce")` (HMAC APP_KEY, security.php:465); send with `Notify::email($email, 'Reset your password', Notify::wrapEmail(...link...))`; if it returns false → `Logger::audit('admin.pwreset.undeliverable')` and show the office phone as fallback. `LoginLog`-style audit `admin.pwreset.requested`. (b) `admin/reset-password.php?t=`: new `Auth::verifyResetToken(string $t): ?int` = split, `Security::verifySignature`, expiry, fetch latest unused `pwreset:<id>` row, `password_verify($nonce, code_hash)`, attempts++ like verifyOtp; on POST (CSRF, min 8, confirm) call existing `Auth::setStaffCredentials($id, ['password'=>$new, 'must_change'=>false], 0)` (clears failed_logins/locked_until and audits, auth.php:730-767), mark row `is_used=1`, `session_regenerate_id(true)`, redirect to login with notice. (c) login.php: replace the line-305 text with a `Forgot password?` link on the admin and agent-pw forms. (d) Setting `staff_pw_reset_enabled` (bool, group security, default 1) and surface `Notify::emailTest` status on staff.php so the office knows SMTP is wired. No new table, no new secrets.
gaps.risk: Low-medium: enumeration if messages differ (keep one message); link usable once and 30 min; depends on SMTP being configured on live (unverified) — keep the office-phone fallback text when Notify::email returns false. Token must be bound to APP_KEY so a config change invalidates outstanding links (acceptable).
gaps.test: New tests/password-reset-test.php (CLI, drives Auth::issuePasswordReset/verifyResetToken with email_enabled=0 so no mail leaves; expired/used/tampered token refused; setStaffCredentials clears locked_until) + extend tests/role-gates-test.php with HTTP GET/POST of both pages and the no-enumeration message; add to tests/run-all.php.

gaps.title: Opt-in 2FA strands the admin when the code is minted but NOT delivered (Twilio down / sender paused / click-to-chat) — the 'no lockout' guarantee is not honoured
gaps.evidence: includes/auth.php:233-249 `$otp = self::issueOtp(...); if (!empty($otp['ok'])) { … Notify::whatsapp($phone, $text); … $_SESSION['admin_2fa_pending'] = …; return ['ok'=>false,'twofa'=>true] }` — return of Notify::whatsapp ignored; includes/notify.php:428-449 on any driver failure `$link = whatsappLink(...); … return $link;` (never throws); the fallback at auth.php:251-253 (`Code could not be minted — degrade to password-only`) only covers mint failure. Local `whatsapp_driver = twilio` with empty `twilio_account_sid` (settings), i.e. every send would fall through to the link.
gaps.proposed_change: In `adminLogin()` and `adminLogin2faResend()` capture delivery: `$sent = (Notify::whatsapp(...) === true); if (Settings::getBool('staff_otp_sms', false)) { $sent = Notify::sms(...) || $sent; }` (and email, see G3); if `!$sent` → `Logger::audit('admin.2fa.delivery_failed', …)` and fall through to `finishAdminSession()` exactly like the no-phone branch, OR (stricter option behind a setting `admin_2fa_strict`) return `['ok'=>false,'error'=>'Could not deliver the code — ask a super-admin to reset 2FA']` without holding the session. Keep `issueOtp` as is.
gaps.risk: Low: only affects accounts that opted in; audit row makes a degraded login visible. Decide with owner whether delivery failure = password-only (availability) or refuse (strict).
gaps.test: Extend tests/admin-2fa-test.php: set `whatsapp_driver=click_to_chat` (Notify returns a link) → adminLogin must return ok=true (or the strict error), never `twofa=true`; assert audit row admin.2fa.delivery_failed.

gaps.title: No optional EMAIL OTP — the second factor is hard-wired to WhatsApp (+ paid SMS when sms_send_otp)
gaps.evidence: includes/auth.php:233 `self::issueOtp('admin:' . $id, 'login', 'whatsapp')`; auth.php:239-240 `Notify::whatsapp(...); if (Settings::getBool('sms_send_otp', false)) { Notify::sms(...); }`; Auth::setAdmin2fa requires a PHONE (auth.php:375-381); otp_codes.channel enum already has 'email' (schema) and Notify::email exists (notify.php:86).
gaps.proposed_change:
Add per-account channel: store `admin_2fa_channels` JSON `{: 'whatsapp'|'email'}` next to `admin_2fa_ids` (Settings::set json, same pattern as S2FA_KEY, auth.php:350-388); `Auth::setAdmin2fa(int $id, bool $on, int $by, string $channel='whatsapp')` requires phone for whatsapp, `admins.email` for email. In adminLogin/Resend: `$channel = self::admin2faChannel($id)`; `issueOtp('admin:'.$id, 'login', $channel)`; deliver by `Notify::email($admin['email'], $company.' login code', Notify::wrapEmail('Login code', '

'.$code.'

…'))` or WhatsApp; apply G2's delivered-check. change-password.php 2FA panel: add a WhatsApp/Email radio (needs the matching contact on file). `adminLogin2faVerify` unchanged (same identifier). Also split the SMS switch: new `staff_otp_sms` (default 0) used by the staff doors instead of `sms_send_otp` (auth.php:240, 339, 549) so an agent OTP login does not trigger a paid SMS by default.

gaps.test: tests/admin-2fa-test.php: enable with channel=email on a throwaway admin with email + `email_enabled=0` → expect password-only completion + delivery_failed audit; with a Notify stub (or `smtp_host` to a local sink) → pending step then verify.

gaps.title: Per-IP login throttle and login-log IP trust client-supplied forwarded headers (spoofable)
gaps.evidence: includes/security.php:483-489 `foreach (['HTTP_CF_CONNECTING_IP','HTTP_X_REAL_IP','HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'] as $header) { if (!empty($_SERVER[$header])) { … return $candidate; } }` with no trusted-proxy check; used by every `Security::rateLimit('admin_login', $ip…)` (auth.php:164, 526, 615) and `LoginLog::record` ip_address (loginlog.php:147). No nginx config in repo to confirm the proxy overwrites these (could not verify). Per-account lockout (auth.php:204-211) still caps guesses at 5 per 15 min per account.
gaps.proposed_change: Honour forwarded headers only when `REMOTE_ADDR` is a configured trusted proxy: add `define('TRUSTED_PROXIES', '127.0.0.1,::1')` to config.sample.php (nginx + php-fpm on the same VPS talk over loopback/socket) and in `clientIp()` check `in_array($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'], explode(',', TRUSTED_PROXIES))` before reading the headers; otherwise return REMOTE_ADDR. Keep header order (CF first).
gaps.risk: Medium if the VPS nginx passes the real IP only through X-Real-IP from a non-loopback address — verify `nginx -T` on the VPS (fastcgi_param REMOTE_ADDR) before enabling; default to loopback-trusted so behaviour is unchanged on the current single-box setup.
gaps.test: tests/admin-security-test.php: set `$_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR']='203.0.113.9'` + `HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR='1.2.3.4'` → `Security::clientIp()` must return 203.0.113.9; with REMOTE_ADDR 127.0.0.1 → 1.2.3.4.

already_satisfied: No staff login path mandates a paid SMS OTP: office door is username+password (auth.php:154-263), agent default door is email+username+password with 'no OTP, no WhatsApp' (auth.php:604-668; login.php:114-118); 2FA is opt-in via admin_2fa_ids (auth.php:350-364), local value `[]`; WaLogin behind wa_login_on=0 (walogin.php:63-66).

Password hashing is bcrypt (Security::hashPassword cost 11, security.php:451-459); unknown-user timing equalised with a dummy password_verify (auth.php:187, 630); OTPs stored bcrypt-hashed, 6 digits, 10-min expiry, 5 attempts (auth.php:1090-1100; otp_codes.max_attempts=5).

Session hygiene: SHGSESSID cookie Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax, use_strict_mode, use_only_cookies, 3h lifetime (bootstrap.php:168-184; live header verified: `secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=10800`), id rotated every 30 min (bootstrap.php:187-192), regenerated on login/logout/password change (auth.php:412, 782; change-password.php:93), idle timeout session_timeout_min=45 (auth.php:799-803), 30-s revalidation signs out deactivated/locked/deleted accounts (auth.php:818-851, tests/admin-session-revalidate-test.php).

Throttling and lockout: per-IP DB buckets for admin_login / agent_pw_login / agent_otp (5 per 5 min, 15-min block; auth.php:164, 526, 615) and *_verify (10 per 10 min; auth.php:285, 569); per-ACCOUNT failed_logins → locked_until 15 min after 5 (auth.php:204-211, 650-655); OTP issue limits 1/min, 6/h per identifier (auth.php:1075-1079); atomic rate_limits upsert (security.php:282-297); throttled attempts are logged (auth.php:169).

Every sign-in outcome is recorded with IP/UA/device (includes/loginlog.php:133-178), new-device detection via httpOnly device cookie (loginlog.php:50-83, 188-232), audit rows admin.login / admin.logout / admin.2fa.* / agent.login (auth.php:453-460, 773, 247, 665).

Server-side role matrix in one place (auth.php:27-111) with superadmin implicit; requireAdmin answers JSON 401/403 for /api/ and a branded 403 page otherwise (auth.php:977-1052); nav is a filter only, pages enforce their own permission (admin_boot list in files); counter agents are scoped by bookingScopeAdminId (auth.php:921-924); peer-superadmin takeover blocked (staff.php:158-162, 187-188); staff management POSTs superadmin-only (staff.php:32-33); shared KV writes need dashboard.view (api/kv.php:61-64, 191).

Forced password change is enforced for HTML pages and the OTP-door deadlock is solved (auth.php:1004-1008; change-password.php:53-70) with HTTP tests (forced-password-change-test.php, otp-forced-password-test.php).

CSRF on every state-changing form/endpoint incl. the login form and agent-signup (security.php:127-151; login.php:127; agent-signup.php:40); HSTS, CSP, nosniff, frame-ancestors live (security.php:27-70, verified by curl).

Email sending is implemented and configurable without Composer: native SMTP client with STARTTLS/SSL + AUTH LOGIN, mail() fallback (notify.php:86-260), settings smtp_host/port/user/pass/secure, mail_from_name, email_enabled seeded (seed.sql:111-119), secrets write-only in Settings UI (settings.php:62-65, 293-312), and a Test-email panel (settings.php:448-462 → Notify::emailTest 2488-2510). Only the SMTP values on live are unverified.
Twilio webhooks validate X-Twilio-Signature (api/whatsapp-webhook.php:92, api/twilio-status.php:69); CRON scripts need CRON_TOKEN (config.sample.php:142).

Test coverage already in tests/run-all.php: admin-security-test (118), admin-2fa-test (119), counter-role-test (106), wa-login-test (156), admin-session-revalidate-test (178), role-gates-test (222, HTTP), forced-password-change + otp-forced-password (68-69), agent-login-bulk-cancel (116).
